intro: Ghana is a top producer of gold and cocoa and also exports oil.

chapters.title: Gold, cocoa and oil
text: Ghana is Africa's biggest gold producer and the world's second-largest cocoa grower after Ivory Coast. Offshore oil began flowing in 2010.
Illegal small-scale gold mining, called galamsey, has polluted rivers.

chapters.title: Services
text: Banking, telecoms and tech start-ups are growing in Accra.
